# Version 4.151.0 (Unreleased)
> **Vulkan, async pixels, and platform**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.0 adds a new Vulkan package, async pixel readback, and broader platform support including Nano Server. The new `SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET` package makes Vulkan rendering accessible via Silk.NET, and async `RequestReadPixels` enables non-blocking GPU pixel reads on `SKImage` and `SKSurface`. FreeType-backed font rendering now works on Nano Server, and test coverage extends to Azure Linux and Alpine/musl.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Upstream Skia m151 bug fixes synced** — The Skia submodule has been updated and chrome/m151 upstream bug-fix patches merged, keeping the bundled engine current with the latest Skia stability work. ([#4537](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4537), [#4538](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4538))

## API Surface

- **Async pixel readback via RequestReadPixels** — A new `RequestReadPixels` method on both `SKImage` and `SKSurface` lets you read pixel data back from the GPU without blocking the render thread, enabling non-blocking readback workflows. ([#4545](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4545))
- **New SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET integration package** — The new package wires SkiaSharp's Vulkan backend to Silk.NET's Vulkan abstraction, making GPU-accelerated Vulkan rendering accessible without writing raw Vulkan setup code. Android and Linux test coverage is included. ([#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527))

## Bug Fixes

- **Memory leak fixed in SKImage.Create raster failure path** — A CoTaskMem pixel buffer was leaked when `SKImage.Create` failed during raster image construction. The buffer is now correctly freed on the failure path. ([#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455))
- **String allocations eliminated in hot paths** — `GetEncodedText` no longer allocates an intermediate string in the null-terminated fast path, and `SKRuntimeEffectUniforms` now pre-sizes its lookup map to the known uniform count, reducing first-access overhead. ([#4498](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4498), [#4512](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4512))

## Platform

- **FreeType font support for Nano Server** — Nano Server deployments can now render text using the FreeType font engine, resolving a long-standing gap in Windows Server container environments. — ❤️ [@jeffska](https://github.com/jeffska) ([#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280))
- **Containerized test coverage for Azure Linux, Alpine/musl, and Nano Server** — CI now validates SkiaSharp against Azure Linux, Alpine/musl, and Nano Server container images, expanding the set of officially tested deployment targets. ([#4515](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4515))
